mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invoice (invoice_number, booking_id, shipper_id, base_amount_value, base_amount_currency, final_amount_value, final_amount_currency, tax_rate, tax_amount_value, discount_rate, discount_amount, payment_status, issued_at, due_date, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{invoiceNumber}, #{bookingId}, #{shipperId}, #{baseAmountValue}, #{baseAmountCurrency}, #{finalAmountValue}, #{finalAmountCurrency}, #{taxRate}, #{taxAmountValue}, #{discountRate}, #{discountAmountValue}, #{paymentStatus}, #{issuedAt}, #{dueDate}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, invoice_number, booking_id, shipper_id, base_amount_value, base_amount_currency, final_amount_value, final_amount_currency, tax_rate, tax_amount_value, discount_rate, discount_amount AS discount_amount_value, payment_status, issued_at, due_date FROM invoice WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, invoice_number, booking_id, shipper_id, base_amount_value, base_amount_currency, final_amount_value, final_amount_currency, tax_rate, tax_amount_value, discount_rate, discount_amount AS discount_amount_value, payment_status, issued_at, due_date FROM invoice WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId}
mapper.update: UPDATE invoice SET final_amount_value = #{finalAmountValue}, final_amount_currency = #{finalAmountCurrency}, tax_amount_value = #{taxAmountValue}, payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invoice_line_item (invoice_id, description, amount_value, amount_currency, seq_number, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{invoiceId}, #{description}, #{amountValue}, #{amountCurrency}, #{seqNumber}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, invoice_id, description, amount_value, amount_currency, seq_number FROM invoice_line_item WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId} ORDER BY seq_number ASC
